notes: loop: periodic = the source cycle closes on its own (+periodExtraFrames when the take stops one frame short); seam = residual end->start mismatch is spread over the cycle; false = one-shot.

feet: contact = planted ground path (Idle sole band, never below rest); body = leg angle relative to the shoulder/hip; blend = contact while the source paw is down, body once it lifts (bodyBlend = lift/leg-length thresholds).
Walk playback is distance driven in Unity (EnemyRigMotion298 WalkMetresPerSecond), so playing a walk 'slower' is not a clip edit: the cadence follows the measured stance-foot speed.

centerStride (locomotion): the planted paw path is centred under the hip, where the near-straight Rig298 legs have the most reach; autoBodyDrop: largest pelvis lowering (fraction of the shortest standing leg) allowed to keep planted paws reachable.
attempts ladder (default): [amplitude, stride] = [1,1] [1,.85] [.85,.85] [.85,.7] [.7,.7] [.7,.55] [.55,.55]; first PASS wins.

mirror: the source is reflected across the body midplane (left/right legs swapped). Bulgasari uses it on every bear clip because its left armpit (Chest/Neck/Fore_L_Upper weights) is the weak skin; all clips are mirrored together so stances stay consistent.

fullCollapse (Death): the pelvis drop is never scaled down by the ladder. tailGroundKeep (default .9): tail joints keep this fraction of their rest ground clearance; a tail that meets the ground bends up instead of floating the body.
Walk = wolf Running_New (trot substitute for the 3.1 m/s chase); the take ends one frame before the cycle closes (periodExtraFrames 1).
Idle = calm breathing window [1,97] of the 21.5 s Idle_New (the rest sniffs the ground and scratches with a hind leg).
Stun = Wolf Boss sturn. TailAttack (extra, toon fox Attack_Tail) is baked for MoveClips but needs a second attack profile to play.
Pace (extra) = wolf Walking: a gentler gait candidate for Walk when Running fails the skin gates (apply override Walk=Pace).

Run (extra, 2026-10-20) = toon fox Fox_Run_InPlace for the D308-120 fox body (fox_spirit x0.7), baked with --tag run (fox_spirit_RT308_run.fbx beside the full FBX, which it never replaces). Passed at k .5 / stride .5 with chainAmplitude .5: stretch 2.425, compression .177, stance slip .019, 4.86x the Pace stance-foot speed. The lowered attempts ladder is a search order, not a gate change - every gate is the Spec value. Swept and rejected the same day: wolf Running_New (stretch 3.21 even at .55; with chainAmplitude .5 + timeScale .8 still 2.64 at .35), Wolf Boss run (2.85, plus fore-paw IK error .025), toon run at full chain amplitude (2.63 / compression .147 at .55), toon run mirrored (passes only at .4), Pace with timeScale .55 (passes, 1.94x Pace, but stance slip 1.23 and the same short stride). The weak skin is the chest midline: adjacent vertices 9025/9023 carry Fore_R_Upper and Fore_L_Upper (cross-side weights), so opposed fore-leg swing stretches it.
